items.rationale: The leaking fitting caused covered escape-of-water damage under §2.4.2. Necessary dismantling and refitting for access or drying is covered under §§5.2.6–5.2.7 at €102 for one service.
Section 5.2.7 covers drying for the period supported by moisture readings. The seven billed days are consistent with the reported drying period; the calibrated gross total is €302.
Section 5.2.6 covers like-for-like restoration of insulation disturbed during necessary access, regardless of whether the fitting itself suffered a covered fracture. One piece is estimated at €30.
Section 5.2.2 covers actual debris disposal once per event. This is the only disposal charge shown, and €60 is consistent with comparable small cellar jobs.
Sections 5.2.6 and 7.1.5 cover the levelling material needed to restore the stripped wall panel. The flat amount is €113, consistent with the comparable repair in Case 50.
Section 5.2.6 covers substrate preparation in the damaged area. The measured 2.40 × 1.16 m rounds to 2.78 m², giving about €206 at €74/m², without paying twice for any included labour.
Section 5.2.6 expressly covers a service opening necessary to reach the damaged element. The comparable charge is €154 for one opening.

Sections 3.5(a), 3.5(e) and 7.1.6 limit payment to ordinary tiles for the 2.78 m² damaged panel plus normal cutting allowance, not the five designer slabs. About 3 m² of standard tile at €52/m² gives €156.
Sections 3.5(a) and 7.1.6 exclude the premium uplift but allow the standard grout needed to finish the reinstated panel. One small pack is estimated at €22 gross.

Sections 3.5(a), 3.5(e) and 7.1.5 limit payment to standard sealant for the 2.40 m bottom joint and 1.16 m corner joint; the other edge was grouted. One standard cartridge for the 3.56 m run is estimated at €16 gross, excluding labour.
Section 7.4.2 permits the first travel charge for the tiling contractor on this invoice. One charge is estimated at €83 gross.
Section 7.4.1 allows necessary skilled labour at customary rates but excludes hours already included in other charges. Comparable cellar repairs support €1,267 for 14 hours, or about €90.50 per hour.
